name: sgs/nav-drawer
title: SGS Nav Drawer
description: The menu panel the burger opens — on any device (phones, tablets, and desktops when the nav's Burger Menu is set to Always). A full-screen native <dialog> modal (top layer — survives a transformed header ancestor). Its body is editable InnerBlocks (the menu, then any blocks); the top row (the × close, an optional per-device logo and one optional heading, label, text or button) is fixed chrome the block renders from its settings. Open/close/focus/scroll-lock/ESC are owned by the shared sgs/nav Interactivity store.

drawerBg.reason: The drawer panel is a disclosure surface toggled open/closed by the burger trigger, not a hover target itself — only its own close button has :hover CSS (style.css). Already correctly painted with a real gradient sibling wired (drawerBgGradient, layered over the flat colour rather than replacing it: an overlay panel keeps its solid base so alpha in the gradient doesn't let the page behind show through).

curtainColour.reason: The curtain is the colour layer that sweeps across the drawer only while its curtain entry or exit animation runs (the dialog ::before, includes/helpers-nav-drawer-motion.php); it takes no pointer events and is gone once the drawer is open, so there is no hover or current state to paint. The gradient sibling (curtainColourGradient) is wired.

chromeRowBg.reason: The chrome row is the drawer's top band (logo, free slot, close), a static surface with no hover or current state of its own; only the controls inside it react. The gradient sibling (chromeRowBgGradient) is wired.

chromeSlotColour.reason: The free slot's colour applies to its heading, label or text types, which are static text with no hover state. The button type carries its own full base-and-hover set (chromeButtonColour*). The gradient sibling (chromeSlotColourGradient) is wired.

closeBorderColour.reason: The close box border keeps one colour; the close button's hover and focus feedback is its existing opacity fade and focus ring (style.css), so there is no second border state to paint.

scrim.label: Backdrop / scrim
scrim._note: The shared viewport scrim (Wave 3C U-2, `includes/helpers-scrim.php::sgs_scrim_render`): the see-through layer printed at wp_footer that dims the page while this block's drawer, dialog or panel is open. Mapped here so the converter can route a draft's scrim colour, strength and blur to these attributes.

curtain.label: Curtain (open animation)
curtain._note: The colour layer that sweeps across the drawer in the `curtain` entry animation (the dialog ::before, includes/helpers-nav-drawer-motion.php). Mapped so the converter can route a draft curtain colour (dogstudio) to curtainColour.

dialog.label: Drawer container
dialog._note: Root `<dialog>`. Block-private (containerMirror:false, per the render.php header note — a `<dialog>` root falls outside SGS_Container_Wrapper's $allowed_tags, so this mirrors the wrapper's fill/box capability without calling it). drawerBg resolves via explicit attrMap (name doesn't carry a Colour/Background suffix). Border (width/style/colour/colour-gradient/radius) is block-private via `SgsBorderControl` in its own dedicated Border panel (Shape B, matching every other SgsBorderControl-adopting block) — explicitly mapped here because `body` also declares the `layout` cluster these members belong to, and the bare (no-`prefix`) suffix convention could not otherwise tell them apart; the border paints the whole drawer surface, not just `body`'s inner padding. Geometry (position/inset/width/height) is driven by `anchor` (per-device enum) + `panelSize` (per-device width cap for the side, trigger and centred anchors) + `anchorOffset` (per-device gap between the panel's top and what it hangs from, trigger and container anchors; mapped to `top`) — see render.php's $sgs_nd_geometry_for_anchor closure. The WCAG-computed foreground (drawerFgHex) has no independent client-facing attribute — it is always DERIVED from drawerBg, never set directly — so css:color (text cluster) is deliberately NOT declared here.

body.label: Drawer content
body._note: The `.sgs-nav-drawer__body` flex column that hosts the editable InnerBlocks (menu/logo/CTA). Layer GRID because it is the arrangement layer for this composite (flex-direction:column is a fixed style.css invariant, not an attribute — honest gap on css:flex-direction). drawerAlign maps to css:align-items (left/center/right -> flex-start/center/flex-end); drawerGap/drawerPadding are the responsive object-model box members.

close.label: Close button
close._note: The undeletable x close button, fixed chrome rendered as a sibling of $content (FR-36-6). toggleCloseColourHover is wired in render.php via sgs_hover_state_rules(), which emits BOTH a touch-guarded :hover rule AND an unguarded :focus-visible colour rule from the same value -- so toggleCloseColourHover controls both states' TEXT colour. Declared explicitly (base attrMap + states.hover.attrMap) rather than relying on the default {prefix}{suffix} convention, which routes both attrs to the SAME (css:color, element=close, state=NULL) slot with no way to tell them apart -- a routing-determinism ambiguity (F6 Check #1/#8), not a manifest gap. The button's :focus-visible OUTLINE (border, not colour) is uncontrolled by any per-block attribute -- it resolves var(--sgs-focus-color, currentColor), following the site-wide focus token, which is correct behaviour, just not this element's colour attrs. closeSize (mirrors sgs/nav-bar-menu's burgerSize, css:width+css:height) and the close-LABEL typography quintet (closeFontSize/closeFontFamily/closeFontWeight/closeTextTransform/closeLetterSpacing, mirrors sgs/nav-bar-menu's burgerFontSize/burgerFontFamily/burgerFontWeight/burgerTextTransform/burgerLetterSpacing) use the same mechanism (sgs_typography_css_rule()) -- see render.php's close-typography block for the closeStyle-dependent text-transform resolution, and closeSize for the icon-vs-text width branch mirroring burgerSize's own triggerMode branch. toggleCloseColourHoverGradient is the Hover gradient sibling of toggleCloseColourGradient; no smart-contrast swap applies to the close button (unlike the bar's itemColourHover). Spec 35 §12 audit item 5 (2026-09-24) added closeRadius (css:border-radius, already a `layout`-cluster member this element declares) and closeOffset (css:transform, a translate() nudge -- also a `layout`-cluster member). closePlacement is DELIBERATELY UNMAPPED: it is an enum POSITION MODE (top-row-end | top-row-start | same-slot), not a routable CSS length/colour/timing value -- the converter's attrMap contract routes a cluster member to a CSS-VALUE-bearing attribute, and closePlacement instead selects which static position rule (top/left/inset-inline-*) applies, which the css:transform/closeOffset entry above already carries the moving part of. Ruling: closePlacement stays out of attrMap by design, not as an oversight. The close box border (closeBorderWidth box object, closeBorderStyle, closeBorderColour) is emitted by includes/nav-drawer-chrome-css.php, with the style written only alongside a real width. The close glyph size (closeIconSize) is its own `closeIcon` element because css:width here already routes to closeSize.

closeIcon.label: Close icon
closeIcon._note: The glyph inside the close button (`.sgs-nav-drawer__close svg`), a per-device length that sets both sides. Emitted by includes/nav-drawer-chrome-css.php.

chrome.label: Top row
chrome._note: The chrome row (Spec 36 FR-36-6): `.sgs-nav-drawer__chrome`, the band at the top of the dialog that holds the close button, the optional logo and the one optional free slot. Rendered by includes/nav-drawer-chrome.php as fixed chrome, never InnerBlocks, and it replaces the 64px top padding the body used to reserve for the close button. A row holding only the close button carries `--close-only` and is dropped with the button under the FR-36-6 `trigger` predicate, so it costs no space.

chromeLogo.label: Top row logo
chromeLogo._note: The optional logo in the chrome row: a `<picture>` art-directed per device from chromeLogoId/chromeLogoUrl and their Tablet/Mobile siblings (the sgs/responsive-logo pattern). It opts out of the generic imageControls path on purpose, per Spec 36 FR-36-6: a logo is a different image per device, not one image with fit and focal controls. chromeLogoShow hides it per device; chromeLogoLink links it home.

chromeSlot.label: Top row slot
chromeSlot._note: The one optional free slot in the chrome row (chromeSlotType heading, label, text or button; chromeSlotText is its words). The typography set uses the `chromeSlot` prefix through sgs_typography_css_rule(); chromeSlotHeadingLevel sets the tag for the heading type (the product-card headingLevel precedent). The button type's look is the separate `chromeButton` element.

chromeButton.label: Top row button
chromeButton._note: The free slot when chromeSlotType is `button`: a link styled by the shared built-in button emitter, sgs_button_element_style_css() with the `chromeButton` prefix (the sgs/modal and sgs/product-card precedent). Its words and typography are the chromeSlot set.

decorative.label: Decorative background
decorative._note: The `.{uid}::before` pseudo-element background-media layer. Declared to resolve a routing collision: `backgroundImage` and `drawerBgGradient` would BOTH resolve to css_property=background-image on css_element=wrapper, identical on every routing axis, so db-consistency would report AmbiguousLayerAttrError (cssprop:ambiguous:sgs/nav-drawer:background-image:OUTER:wrapper::) and the clone-time resolver would pick by rowid. They are NOT the same target: render.php states the image paints on `.{uid}::before` and NEVER on the dialog root, precisely because the root already carries drawerBg/drawerBgGradient and a background-image there would overwrite the gradient rather than layer with it. Mirrors sgs/container's media-LAYER pattern and reuses the `decorative` element token sgs/cta-section already declares for its identical background-media layer (cta-section.backgroundMedia -> background-image -> decorative). Only backgroundImage is claimed here; the size/position/repeat/attachment companions keep their existing routing.

surfaceBlur.description: Backdrop blur: a single CSS length (for example 24px) that blurs whatever sits behind the drawer. Empty emits nothing. Emitted through includes/helpers-surface-ground.php.

surfaceSaturate.description: Backdrop saturation as a whole-number percentage (for example 150), paired with surfaceBlur. Unset emits nothing; 0 is a legal value.

surfaceOpacity.description: Fill translucency, 0 to 1, applied to the drawer background colour (drawerBg). A gradient or image fill is left as it is. Unset or 1 emits nothing.

shadow.description: Drawer shadow: a theme shadow preset slug (whisper, soft, lifted, floating, crisp, long, outline, grounded, glow, pressed, hard) or a raw layer stack composed with shadowColour. Empty means no shadow.

shadowColour.description: Colour for a raw shadow shape in `shadow`; ignored when `shadow` is a theme preset slug.

attributes._comment_closeStyle: Wave 3C U-9/U-11 (.claude/reports/2026-09-24-u9-u11-design.md §4.1): a TIER OBJECT -- desktop is concrete, tablet inherits desktop, mobile inherits tablet, fallback separate-x. FIVE values now (Spec 41 FR-41-12's four plus NEW `trigger`, §4.2 -- "the menu button closes it", the revised FR-36-6 predicate). `separate-x` and `text-swap` are the icon/text DISPLAY axis and mirror sgs/nav-bar-menu's triggerMode; `burger-morph` is a GLYPH choice (a CSS-drawn two-bar span); `trigger` renders identically to `separate-x` whenever it actually renders -- the predicate decides whether it renders at all. Its PHP twin is render.php::$sgs_nd_allowed_close_styles and BOTH lists must carry all five values -- a value one side accepts and the other rejects coerces silently, with no error on either side. A stored FLAT string (pre-migration content) is migrated by scripts/migrate-stored-tier-scalars.py (folds to {desktop:<value>}) -- render.php also defends against an unmigrated flat string directly.
attributes._comment_closePlacement: §4.3 -- top-row-end (default, today's position) | top-row-start | same-slot (× centred on the burger's own spot; store.js measures + writes --sgs-nav-close-x/-y). Tier object; PHP resolves `same-slot` to `top-row-end` when `modality` is `non-modal` (the header paints above a non-modal drawer, so a × under the burger would be unreachable by pointer).
attributes._comment_closeOffset: §4.3 -- {x,y} px, -40 to 40, tier object. x is on the INLINE axis (mirrors under RTL); applied as translate() after placement.
attributes._comment_closeOnScrollDistance: §4.6 (DEC-02 carve-out) -- a PLAIN NUMBER in px, 0 to 200, default 0 (off); NOT a tier object (one reference, one value). Above 0, the page drops its scroll lock and closes on user-intended pointer scrolling (wheel or touchmove/pointer-drag within 150ms) past this distance -- never on keyboard, scroll-anchoring or a programmatic scroll -- and never while motion-utils.js::isTouchInput() is true.
attributes._comment_closeRadius: §4.10 (Bean, 2026-09-24) -- tier object of CSS lengths (sgs_css_length_value), default {} = today's hardcoded 4px on .sgs-nav-drawer__close (style.css).

closeBorderWidth.description: Close box border width, a {top,right,bottom,left} box of CSS lengths (1.5px is fine), one value for every device like every SgsBorderControl width. Unset draws no border. Emitted by includes/nav-drawer-chrome-css.php.

closeBorderStyle.description: Close box border style, written only where closeBorderWidth is set.

closeBorderColour.description: Close box border colour: a palette slug or any colour. Unset follows the close button's text colour.

closeIconSize.description: Close glyph size per device, a CSS length for both sides of the icon. Unset keeps the stylesheet's 28px (20px beside a word).

attributes._comment_accordionExclusive: ENG-02 (§4.7) -- default true (today's exclusive `<details name>` accordion). Published as context `sgs/navDrawerAccordionExclusive` (providesContext, above); nav-drawer-menu's sgs_nav_drawer_menu_render_items() omits `name=` when false, letting more than one panel stay open (away's reference).
attributes._comment_closeLabel_closeIcon: Spec 41 FR-41-12 -- the close button's word and glyph, mirroring sgs/nav-bar-menu's triggerLabel / triggerIcon. NEITHER gets a JSON enum (closeLabel is free text; closeIcon is an object), and NEITHER gets a supports.sgs.elements member: they route no CSS property, so an element entry would be a phantom routing slot -- the same ruling Spec 41 section 8.6(e) makes for triggerMode/triggerLabel. The close button's COLOUR is wired via toggleCloseColour / toggleCloseColourHover / toggleCloseColourGradient on the `close` element.

chromeRowHeight.description: Top row minimum height per device, a CSS length. Unset is 64px.

chromeRowGap.description: Space between the logo, the free slot and the close button, per device. Unset is 12px.

chromeRowPadding.description: Top row padding per device, a {top,right,bottom,left} box. Unset is 0 top and bottom, 12px either side.

chromeRowBg.description: Top row fill: a palette slug or any colour. Unset shows the drawer's own background.

chromeRowBgGradient.description: Top row gradient fill; non-empty wins over chromeRowBg.

chromeLogoId.description: Top row logo, desktop: media library attachment ID. Wins over chromeLogoUrl.

chromeLogoUrl.description: Top row logo URL, desktop, stored alongside the ID.

chromeLogoIdTablet.description: Tablet logo attachment ID; unset uses the desktop logo.

chromeLogoIdMobile.description: Mobile logo attachment ID; unset uses the tablet logo.

chromeLogoAlt.description: Logo alt text. Unset uses the image's own alt text; a linked logo with none is named after the site ("<site name> home").

chromeLogoLink.description: The logo links to the home page.

chromeLogoWidth.description: Logo width per device, a CSS length; the height follows the image. Unset is 32px tall.

chromeLogoShow.description: Show the logo, per device (true or false). Unset shows it wherever a logo is set.

chromeSlotType.description: The top row's one free slot: none, a heading, a label, a line of text or a button.

chromeSlotText.description: The slot's words (the button's label for the button type).

chromeSlotHeadingLevel.description: The tag for the heading type.

chromeSlotUrl.description: Where the button goes. A button with no link is not rendered.

chromeSlotNewTab.description: The button opens in a new tab.

chromeSlotPlacement.description: Where the slot sits in the row: straight after the logo, centred in the row, or at the end beside the close button.

chromeSlotShow.description: Show the slot, per device (true or false). Unset shows it.

chromeSlotColour.description: Text colour of the heading, label or text slot. Unset follows the drawer's text colour.

chromeSlotColourGradient.description: Text gradient for the heading, label or text slot; non-empty wins over chromeSlotColour.

entryAnimation.description: How the drawer arrives and leaves, per device: auto (follows the anchor), none, fade, slide-start, slide-end, slide-up, slide-down, wipe-down, wipe-down-skew, reveal-from-bar, curtain, scale or grow-from-anchor (the box's real height grows from its anchor's height, top fixed). The exit is the reverse. Allow-list: includes/helpers-nav-drawer-motion.php::sgs_nav_drawer_motion_shapes.

entryEasing.description: Speed curve for the opening and closing, from the shared motion easing list (includes/helpers-motion-easing.php).

entryEasingCustom.description: A cubic-bezier() curve, read only when entryEasing is custom. Validated; an invalid curve falls back to ease-out.

entryFade.description: Slides and wipes also fade in and out. Off for a pure slide.

curtainColour.description: Colour of the layer that sweeps across in the curtain animation. Unset uses the drawer's text colour.

curtainColourGradient.description: A CSS gradient for the curtain layer; non-empty wins over curtainColour.

itemStagger.description: Delay between each top-level menu item arriving, in milliseconds. 0 turns the stagger off.

itemStaggerDistance.description: How far each item travels as it arrives, per device, in pixels. Negative means it falls from above. Unset is 16.

itemStaggerDuration.description: Each item's own arrival time in milliseconds. 0 uses the drawer's opening time.

itemStaggerMax.description: Cap on an item's delay in milliseconds, so a long menu does not keep arriving. 0 means no cap.

itemStaggerOnClose.description: Items leave one after another, last first, when the drawer closes.

itemStaggerAxis.description: Which way each staggered item travels, per device: vertical (default; the sign of itemStaggerDistance picks up or down), start (in from the inline-start edge) or end (in from the inline-end edge). Start and end mirror in right-to-left languages. includes/helpers-nav-drawer-stagger-shape.php.

itemStaggerReveal.description: How each staggered item appears: translate (travel and fade) or clip (travel while a clip uncovers it top to bottom, no fade).

scrimFadeDuration.description: Fade time of the dimmed layer behind the drawer, in milliseconds. 0 fades it with the drawer.

modality.description: Modal (default) uses native showModal() — the visible page is fully inert. non-modal uses show() with freezeBackground()'s selective inert, keeping the header/burger row live and keyboard-reachable while the drawer is open. Never pair non-modal with aria-modal="true" on the dialog — that would hide the deliberately-live header from assistive tech.

backgroundImageDecorative._comment: Spec 35 item 18 / {element}Decorative convention. render.php paints this image as a CSS background (::before layer), never a frontend — the only literal is the operator-only preview thumbnail in edit.js. Default true documents that. When explicitly set false with alt text on the picked image, render.php adds an aria-describedby hidden note to the dialog (the dialog's own aria-label is already claimed for the drawer's accessible name, so the image description is layered on rather than overwriting it).

drawerTextColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of drawerTextColourHover. Non-empty wins over drawerTextColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

toggleCloseColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of toggleCloseColourHover. Non-empty wins over toggleCloseColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible. Mirrors toggleCloseColourGradient's Normal-state resolution unconditionally -- unlike nav-menu's itemColourHoverGradient, no smart-contrast swap applies to this control.

closeSize.description: Mirrors nav-menu's burgerSize (css:width/css:height, Spec 41). Sets the close button's box size in px. Default 44px reproduces the CURRENT effective size exactly — style.css's base rule already sets min-width/min-height:44px with no explicit width/height, so an unset value renders byte-identical. Under text-swap/icon-and-text (closeStyle), render.php keeps width:auto (mirrors burgerSize's own triggerMode branch — a button carrying a word cannot be forced back to a fixed square) and applies this value to height/min-width/min-height only; under separate-x/burger-morph it sets a fixed width+height square, matching the current icon-only rendering.

closeFontSize.description: Spec 41 close-button typography (mirrors nav-menu's burgerFontSize mechanism, sgs_typography_css_rule()). Targets the close LABEL text span (.sgs-nav-drawer__close-text), only rendered under text-swap/icon-and-text closeStyle. Default '14' + closeFontSizeUnit 'px' reproduces style.css's pre-existing hardcoded font-size:14px exactly, so an untouched drawer (any closeStyle) renders byte-identical.

closeFontFamily.description: Close-button label font-family. Unset = no declaration (inherits ambient font), matching current behaviour — style.css never hardcoded a font-family for the close label.

closeFontWeight.description: Reproduces style.css's pre-existing hardcoded font-weight:600 on the close label exactly.

closeTextTransform.description: Left unset by default deliberately — the PRE-EXISTING hardcoded value differs by closeStyle (text-swap: uppercase; icon-and-text: none, style.css never declared it there), so a single flat default cannot represent both without changing one of them. render.php resolves the byte-identical per-style default only when this is empty; once an operator sets a value it applies uniformly to both text-bearing styles.

closeLetterSpacing.description: Tier object mirroring burgerLetterSpacing's shape. Default resolves to 0.05em (see closeLetterSpacingUnit), reproducing style.css's pre-existing hardcoded letter-spacing:0.05em on the close label exactly.

drawerAlign.description: How the drawer's InnerBlocks content sits in the body flex column. left/center/right map to align-items flex-start/center/flex-end; stretch makes a child (a container or a row of buttons) span the full width of the drawer — the only way for a row to fill it, since align-items can only move a shrunk-to-content box, never widen it. Default left. FR-U18-G7.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColour.

scrimColour.description: Backdrop tint colour behind the drawer: a token slug or hex. Emitted through includes/helpers-scrim.php.

scrimColourGradient.description: Backdrop gradient sibling of scrimColour; non-empty wins over the flat colour.

scrimOpacity.description: Backdrop tint strength per device, 0 to 1. Default reproduces the drawer's previous hardcoded rgba(0,0,0,0.55) exactly.

scrimBlur.description: Backdrop blur of the page behind the drawer per device, a CSS length. Unset emits no blur.
